item.title: Outbound v1.6
item.description: Slower Macs now paint the landscape in small steps, which should fix the wallpaper standing still there after 1.5, and Outbound opens on the same view your desktop showed when you shut down. Pause When Hidden is now on by default and holds the painting while windows cover nearly all of every desktop, so it uses far less of your Mac while you work. The menu says why the painting is holding still, Settings has buttons for the website, support, feedback and updates, and feedback sent from the app notes how the painting runs on your Mac.

item.title: Outbound v1.5
item.description: New Pause When Hidden option holds the flight while windows cover every desktop. A Feedback item in the menu lets you write to me directly, and the painted border now stays off unless you turn it on.

item.title: Outbound v1.4
item.description: The painting now stays on the lock screen and the login window, and quitting puts your own picture back on every desktop. Outbound uses about half the memory, starts sooner after an update, and moves between desktops without a jump. New installs start without the painted border.

item.title: Outbound v1.3
item.description: A new look: real trees and shadows, rivers that bend, cars that keep to the road with soft low beams, and a redrawn Lapland, La Pampa and Niigata. Outbound now speaks your Mac's language, the painted border can be turned off from the menu bar, it can stay over one place, and no light flickers any more.

item.title: Outbound v1.2
item.description: Light, seasons, pace, time at each place and battery choices are now in the menu bar, under a new gull icon. Settings always opens in front of your other windows.

item.title: Outbound v1.1
item.description: Smoother on every display: frames reach the screen at an even 30 a second, the bird keeps up with the cursor, and Fly To no longer stutters. Pasting a license key works, and Outbound now runs on macOS 13 Ventura and later.

item.title: Outbound v1.0
item.description: The first release of Outbound. It keeps itself up to date from here on.
